repair_diagnostics.repair_context: Ordinary repair receives signature, errors, and normalized payload. It has no original code/spec section. Safe-subset repair receives original code/spec and extra context, and omits the earlier candidates and errors.

replay_limit: Historical replies are reused only for identical prompts. Changed or new repair prompts are censored. Earlier returns are deterministic counterfactuals on the saved responses. These counts measure validation and repair behavior, not accuracy.

strict_ablation.method: Original p03 and RQ1 status criteria. Unchanged final formulas retain archived verdicts. Changed identified finals are rescored. The same nine DEV tasks with parseable gold are used in every variant. Bounds treat inconclusive, unclassified and censored outcomes as failure/success, respectively.
